name: Kogirei Tuli
source:
An effeminate onee-type who loves tulips and art.

With the brain of a flower garden, even in a dream world where he can't see the shadows of anyone other than himself, he is drawing pictures while enjoying the "unusual scenery"...

[Translated from [url=https://romankessha.wixsite.com/sadisma]official website[/url]]
